ownerDecisions.question: Phase13 guide يحتوي معيار OR، Mapper يشترط دراسة مجانية، Public/Publisher يشترطان مجانية الدراسة والشهادة معًا. أي سياسة مستقبلية ينبغي تعريفها بوضوح؛ **مرشح منطقي**: دراسة مجانية شرط الكتالوج المجاني، شهادة مجانية خاصية مستقلة، لا ضمان شهادة دون دليل.

independentAcceptanceNotYetProven.remaining: Full owner publish/review/invalidation and public surfaces after mutation; current evidence is selected real writes and reads, not all end-to-end publication histories.
Full controlled import-to-owner promotion, worker crash before/after durable ack, provenance across refresh and retry. Existing concurrency identities and completion worker proof are foundations.

Learning-path completion and successful P14 credential issuance/render/verification under approved authority, template, signing configuration and real storage. Synthetic complete-course progress is not pedagogical or external credential authority.
Secure real object delivery and revocation of an already delivered link; attestations use actual services over synthetic preverified asset records. Missing secure delivery capability fails closed.
External payment capture/refund/bank settlement success and ambiguous provider outcome recovery. No external provider authorized or invoked. Local wallet settlement and absence guards are separate.
Complete owner/parent/reference lifecycle changes across multiple pages with snapshot/count consistency, not just next-read withdrawal.
Full production principal/MFA/duty and private-graph surface matrix beyond current actual mounted JWT/RBAC/session tests.
